prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” agency — the right choice depends on what your organization needs (branding vs lead generation vs physician recruitment), your budget, your timeline, and whether you need deep healthcare regulatory/clinical experience. Instead of naming one winner, here’s a practical approach so you can find the best healthcare-marketing partner in St. Louis for your situation.

Key selection criteria
- Healthcare experience: proven case studies for hospitals, practices, medical device, or pharma (whichever matches you).  
- Compliance: HIPAA, patient privacy, and familiarity with healthcare advertising rules.  
- Measurable results: clear KPIs, before/after metrics (traffic, leads, cost per acquisition, conversion rates).  
- Full-service vs specialist: do you need integrated brand + digital or just SEO/PPC/content?  
- Local relationships: connections with local media, physician referral networks, and community outreach.  
- Team stability & expertise: access to strategists, creative, data analysts, and account leads.  
- References & reputation: client references, reviews, and relevant awards/case studies.  
- Reporting & transparency: dashboards, cadence of reporting, and communication style.  

Types of agencies to consider in St. Louis
- Large integrated agencies with healthcare practice groups — best if you want a full strategy + execution across channels.  
- Boutique healthcare specialists — good for deep clinical/regulatory understanding and focused campaigns.  
- Digital/SEO/PPC specialists — best when your priority is leads and performance marketing.  
- Creative/brand agencies — when you need rebranding, patient experience design, or TV/radio production.

Suggested interview/questions to ask finalists
- Can you show 2–3 healthcare case studies with specific results?  
- How do you handle HIPAA and patient data in marketing campaigns?  
- Which channels drove the best outcomes for similar clients (SEO, paid search, social, email)?  
- What KPIs do you recommend and how often do you report?  
- Who will be on the day-to-day team and can we meet them?  
- How do you measure and reduce cost-per-lead?  
- Can you provide local references?  
- What’s your pricing model and estimated timeline for our goals?

Next steps I can take for you
- If you tell me what kind of healthcare organization you are (hospital, specialty clinic, dental, med device, payer), what services you need, and your budget/timeline, I’ll compile a tailored shortlist of St. Louis agencies (with strengths and questions to ask each).  
- Or I can give a template RFP or scorecard you can use to evaluate agencies.

Which route would you like to take?
